proposal.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – 24-month proposal for part:350020
proposal.body:
Dear Ms Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your offer. We propose a 24-month renewal for the full 4,580 pcs per year, which gives you secure volume through 2028. Our forecast fc:350020@2026-09 records a 10.3 % volume change, so this is a growing part for you. Our current agreement ctr:4600070530 runs on 90 days payment, and we would like to keep that. Given your pricing committee approves changes above 2 %, could you please take our proposal to its next meeting? Please also share your earliest lead time and any cheaper variant.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

proposal.subject: Fastener kit bundle - 24/36-month proposal
proposal.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

Thank you for your offer. We are prepared to bundle all four kit items, about 30,000 kits a year, with you for 24 or 36 months instead of 12.

Your call note doc:20260514-70610-M3 records that your second shift has been on hold since spring, so this volume fills idle capacity. The main cost driver, steel index PPI-C2594, rose only from 114.4 (idx:PPI-C2594@2025-08) to 116.3 (idx:PPI-C2594@2026-08), a change of 1.66%.

As these packages differ from your quote by more than 2%, please submit them to your pricing committee for an authorized review. Could you also share the price build-up per kit component?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

proposal.subject: Part 350011 – price adjustment 2027, payment terms
proposal.body:
Dear Ms Lechner,

Thank you for your offer and the cost explanation for the 7.5 kW motor. We recognise the copper development and can accept your EUR 370.96 per unit without an index clause.

Our current agreement ctr:4600070510 provides 90 days payment. We ask that this term be kept for the 2027 supply of 6,110 pcs. This gives you a full-year volume at your requested price with stable, predictable terms.

We have attached two packages: 90 days as our preference, or 60 days as an alternative. If your pricing committee needs to approve this, could you please submit it at its next meeting? Please confirm the package you can make your standing offer.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

proposal.subject: Part 370010 – price basis 2027
proposal.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

Thank you for your offer. Your letter doc:20260706-70710-M1 states that your nickel and alloy requirement is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so the AS-14404 movement does not reach your costs at the start of the new period. Our forecast fc:370010@2026-09 records a change of +1.9 % in volume for this part. We therefore propose a longer commitment at the current price level, without an index clause. Please see our attached packages.

Your owner kindly offered to walk us through your calculation of hourly rates and material. Could we schedule that? If the price is above your authority, please arrange an authorized pricing review.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

proposal.subject: Bearing bracket HN (part:310020) – 2027 supply and quality commitment
proposal.body:
Dear Mr Lis,

Thank you for your offer. A 6400 ppm commitment is not acceptable to us. Your scorecard sc:70140@2026Q3 shows 2376 ppm with 63.5 % on-time delivery, so we need a binding improvement plan. Our forecast fc:310020@2026-09 records a 20.0 % volume increase, which gives you stable, growing business. Steel index PPI-D351 fell from 137.0 to 131.9 (-3.72 %) between 2025-08 and 2026-08.

We propose the attached packages, with 60-day payment and 12 months at 15,900 pcs. Could you share the cost of reaching 300 ppm and your earliest reliable lead time?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

proposal.subject: Part 340010: firm 24-month commitment for full volume
proposal.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your offer. You prioritise firm long-term commitments, so we propose to commit our full 23,400 pc per year for 24 or 36 months at a 42-day lead time.

LCI-C labour costs moved from 116.5 to 119.6 (idx:LCI-C@2026-06), a change of 2.66%. PPI-C2219 moved from 117.8 to 122.4 (idx:PPI-C2219@2026-08), a change of 3.9%. At the estimated cost weights, these changes justify only a small adjustment to our current €29.89, not €32.20.

Please submit the attached packages to your pricing committee for an authorised review. Could you also share your earliest achievable lead time and a cost breakdown?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

proposal.subject: Part 370010 – 24-month price basis proposal
proposal.body:

In exchange, we propose a 24-month contract at a fixed price with no index clause, which gives you planning security.

Please see our attached term sheets. As the increase from our current price exceeds 2 %, could you please submit them to your pricing committee for an authorized review? We would also appreciate a cost breakdown, as your owner offered, and any cheaper variant you can suggest.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

proposal.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070530 – proposal for a 24-month frame agreement
proposal.body:

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

proposal.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – 24-month proposal for 6306-2Z C3
proposal.body:

Thank you for your offer. We propose a 24-month volume agreement for 20,000 pc a year, as you indicated that multi-year agreements are what move prices.

idx:PPI-C2815@2026-08 went from 118.8 to 119.8, a change of 0.84%.
idx:LCI-C@2026-06 went from 116.5 to 119.6, a change of 2.66%.

fc:360020@2026-09 records a 4.2% increase in our demand for this part.

Please review the attached packages. If one suits you, could you make it your standing offer? Could you also send a short cost breakdown and tell us the earliest date you can confirm?

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

proposal.subject: Part 350011 – 2027 terms for Motor IE3 7.5 kW

proposal.subject: HN 50-200 volute casings – counterproposal on price adjustment
proposal.body:

Could you share a cost breakdown showing material, energy and labour? We want a price that keeps your foundry healthy.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Kind regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

proposal.subject: Part 340010 – firm 24/36-month commitment for full volume

Hollerau Pumpenwerke Purchasing

proposal.subject: Part 370010 – price basis 2027: proposal for a longer agreement
proposal.body:

limitations: No arena sessions or supplier model calls: these are decisions on recorded public openings.
Validity and arithmetic can be assessed; proposed packages are not accepted deals and have no actual score.
Every variant gets 240 seconds to measure latency; the live runner enforces 25 seconds per decision.
score_if_accepted applies the hosted C_open/C_best of the recorded session to the cheapest proposed package: an upper bound on ambition, not a result.
Stopped after 27 of 30 decisions: the replay script shared one SQLite-backed data package across worker threads.

budget.price_basis: Conservative standard estimate: all input at 1.25x default 30-minute cache-write rate, output at standard rate; not a billing reconciliation
